MEMORY ARENA - GOI CLIENT

1. Cai JDK 17 tro len tren may nguoi choi.
2. Giai nen goi nay va chay run-client.bat.
3. Tai man hinh dang nhap:
   - May chu: nhap dia chi IPv4 cua may dang chay Server.
   - Cong: 12345.
   - Moi nguoi dung mot tai khoan khac nhau.
4. Cac may phai cung LAN/Wi-Fi, hoac cung mang Radmin VPN/ZeroTier.
5. Cach bat dau:
   - Ghep nhanh: moi nguoi bam San sang, Server dem nguoc 3 giay va tu bat dau.
   - Phong rieng: moi nguoi bam San sang, chu phong bam Bat dau, Server dem nguoc 3 giay.

May Client khong can chay run-server.bat.
